title: Control and Estimation Co-Design via Envelope-Theorem Gradients
summary: Instead of the sequential plant--control--estimator design pipeline, which is in general not optimal, we propose the Control and Estimation Co-Design (ContEst) framework, which poses the entire system design as a single two-stage problem solved by first-order methods. A key enabler is that the gradient of each inner control/estimation optimal cost with respect to the design parameters is available from the dual variables the inner solver already returns, by the envelope theorem: exactly under mild regularity (a unique inner minimizer), and as a subgradient under more relaxed conditions.
